en.江宜汾以溝通力、表達力與思考力為核心設計課程，依不同年齡與學習需求，陪伴學習者理: Konya Chiang designs courses in communication, expression and critical thinking, helping learners of different ages understand themselves, empathize with others and communicate clearly.
en.江宜汾 | 溝通・表達・思考力課程設計: Konya Chiang | Communication, Expression & Critical Thinking
en.我是江宜汾，以溝通力、表達力與思考力為核心設計課程。從接納自己、同理他人，到形成: I’m Konya Chiang. I design courses that connect communication, expression and critical thinking. From understanding our feelings and listening with empathy to forming and sharing a point of view, I help learners of all ages think clearly, express themselves and work with others.
en.江宜汾帶領學生進行課堂討論: Konya Chiang leading a classroom discussion
en.面對 AI 持續改變學習與工作的時代，我關注人如何理解自己、辨別資訊、形成判斷，: As AI reshapes learning and work, I focus on how people understand themselves, evaluate information, make judgments and collaborate. My courses connect communication, thinking and expression through questions, discussion and real-world tasks.
en.理解自己，也聽懂他人: Understand yourself and listen to others
en.從接納自己的感受與需要開始，練習同理、傾聽與換位思考。理解事情有不同角度，在差異: Begin by acknowledging your feelings and needs, then practise empathy, listening and perspective-taking. Explore different ways of seeing a situation and find room for dialogue and cooperation.
en.練習方向｜自我覺察・觀點交換・合作對話: Practice: Self-awareness · Exchanging perspectives · Collaborative dialogue
en.釐清問題，形成自己的判斷: Clarify questions and make your own judgments
en.透過提問與探索，區分事實、觀點與假設，檢視資訊和理由。練習形成有依據的看法，也保: Through inquiry and exploration, distinguish facts, opinions and assumptions, and examine information and reasoning. Build evidence-based views while remaining open to reconsidering them.
en.練習方向｜問題探索・資訊判讀・觀點形成: Practice: Inquiry · Evaluating information · Developing a point of view
en.整理思緒，讓想法被理解: Organize your thoughts so others can understand
en.將思考轉化為有結構、有邏輯的表達。從對話、採訪到分享與演說，依對象和情境組織內容: Turn ideas into structured, logical communication. From conversations and interviews to presentations and talks, learn to organize content for your audience and purpose.
en.練習方向｜內容組織・敘事表達・分享回饋: Practice: Content structure · Storytelling · Sharing and feedback
en.同一個核心，適合不同年齡的學習深度: A shared foundation, adapted to different ages
en.可依兒童、青少年、家長或成人的需求，調整議題、活動與思考深度，規劃單場工作坊或系: Topics, activities and depth can be adapted for children, teenagers, parents and adults, as one-off workshops or course series. I welcome collaborations with schools, educational organizations and communities in Taiwan and mainland China.
en.這些是我過往與教育機構合作的課程案例，也是持續發展課程的實踐基礎。新的合作可依學: These courses with educational organizations form the practical foundation of my ongoing curriculum development. New collaborations can adapt the themes, depth and activities to learners’ ages, learning goals and settings.

Through sorting activities, games, discussions and interviews, they practise evaluating information and understanding different perspectives, then organize and present their views in a mini debate.

en.辯論是課程中的表達練習。學生輪流說明立場、提出理由，也聆聽並回應對方，將課堂裡學: Debate gives students a chance to practise expression. They take turns explaining their positions, giving reasons, listening and responding, bringing inquiry, thinking and communication into a live presentation.
en.分辨事實、感受與想法，認識情緒與內在反應。: Distinguish facts, feelings and thoughts, and recognize emotions and inner reactions.
en.透過「想法眼鏡」練習，為挫折找到不同的理解與行動。: Use “thinking glasses” activities to explore different interpretations and responses to setbacks.
en.從畫畫接龍到真假訊息辨識，練習查證與媒體識讀。: From drawing relays to spotting false information, practise verification and media literacy.
en.比較不同觀點，透過角色反轉練習同理與傾聽。: Compare perspectives and use role reversal to practise empathy and listening.
en.練習開放式提問、一次聚焦一件事，避免在問題裡預設答案。: Ask open-ended questions, focus on one thing at a time and avoid suggesting an answer in the question.
en.整理理由，練習清楚發言，透過迷你辯論回應不同意見。: Organize reasons, speak clearly and respond to different opinions through a mini debate.
en.分辨事實、感受與想法的五明課堂實況: LIA students sorting facts, feelings and thoughts
en.透過分類與討論，練習把發生的事情和自己的解讀分開。: Use sorting and discussion to separate what happened from how we interpret it.
en.整理想法，練習分享的五明課堂實況: LIA students organizing and sharing their ideas
en.從小組整理到課堂發表，讓自己的想法被同學理解。: Move from group work to classroom presentations so classmates can understand your thinking.
en.畫畫接龍：訊息如何改變的五明課堂實況: LIA drawing relay activity exploring how messages change
en.觀察訊息經過傳遞後的差異，練習回頭確認原始內容。: Notice how a message changes as it is passed along, and check it against the original.
en.在討論中聽見不同觀點的五明課堂實況: LIA students listening to different perspectives in a group discussion
en.輪流表達與傾聽，理解每個人看待事情的角度。: Take turns speaking and listening to understand how others see a situation.
en.角色反轉與情境演練的五明課堂實況: LIA students taking part in a role-reversal activity
en.用不同角色進入情境，練習同理與溝通。: Step into different roles to practise empathy and communication.
en.一起觀察、提問與合作的五明課堂實況: LIA students observing, asking questions and working together
en.透過共同任務，練習交換想法、整理內容與協作。: Use shared tasks to exchange ideas, organize content and collaborate.
en.與好好聽共同製作，累積超過 100 集的教育對話。: More than 100 education conversations, co-produced with Hao Hao Ting.
en.從教室、家庭到未來社會，透過訪談與思辨，讓更多人看見學習可以發生的不同方式。精選: Through interviews and reflection, the podcast explores learning in classrooms, families and a changing society. Selected clips are also shared on the 1221 Future Education Development Association’s Facebook page.

en.陪伴並不是完美解答，: Support is about more than answers.
en.而是穩定地在場。: It is about being steadily present.
en.孩子成長的路上，家長也值得被理解與支持。: As children grow, parents deserve understanding and support too.
en.六週引導歷程，每週一次、每次兩小時，陪伴家長從看見自己開始，在理解與接納中，建立: A six-week facilitated journey, meeting once a week for two hours. Starting with self-awareness, parents build a steadier foundation of family support through understanding and acceptance.
en.看見自己的狀態與需要: Recognize your own state and needs
en.從自動反應，回到有選擇的陪伴。: From automatic reactions to intentional parenting.
en.在 ARC 家長圈裡，我們不只處理孩子的行為，也陪家長看見自己被觸發的瞬間：內在: In ARC Parent Circle, we explore children’s behavior alongside the moments that trigger parents: how needs, core fears, old patterns and beliefs can drive control, anxiety or lecturing. Through RECODE, parents revisit their reactions and practise clearer, steadier ways of relating to their children.

en.透過雙講師引導、個案剖析與實作，在刺激與反應之間找回選擇回應的空間。: Two facilitators guide case discussions and hands-on activities to help participants find space to choose a response between stimulus and reaction.
en.辨識大腦如何快速下結論，看見自己的慣性與防衛。: Recognize how the mind jumps to conclusions and identify habitual responses and defenses.
en.區分客觀事實與主觀詮釋，鬆開習慣性的腦補。: Separate observable facts from interpretations and question the stories we fill in.
en.理解個人防衛如何影響溝通、部門協作與組織決策。: Understand how personal defenses affect communication, cross-team collaboration and organizational decisions.
en.運用心智暫停、呼吸定錨，在高壓情境中練習回應。: Use brief mental pauses and grounding breaths to practise responding under pressure.
en.在相遇與對話中感受人生。: Explore life through encounters and conversation.
en.2025 年起，我在台北開辦 C+ Salon，邀請藝術、文化、國學、科技等不同: I started C+ Salon in Taipei in 2025, inviting speakers from the arts, culture, Chinese classics and technology to exchange ideas with participants and bring different perspectives into everyday life.
